rationale: The current Docusaurus 3.10.2 dependency graph reports inherited npm advisories without a complete automated fix.
This baseline is temporary risk visibility, not acceptance of safety or a vulnerability waiver.
Any critical vulnerability, count increase, new advisory source or expired review date fails the gate.
limitations: Counts include transitive propagation across the dependency graph.
A passing regression gate does not mean the known vulnerabilities were remediated.
Human review and dependency upgrade investigation remain mandatory.
